faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: About pricing, the app, and clinic registration.

q1.q: Is the app free for patients?
q1.a: Yes. Every feature is 100% free for patients.

q2.q: How much are the clinic plans?
q2.a: Starter is $70 per month. Pro is $100 per month. Prices are in US dollars and billing is monthly.

q3.q: How do I book an appointment?
q3.a: Open the app, choose a clinic, and book online. You do not need to call.

q4.q: Where do I download the app?
q4.a: On the App Store and Google Play. The links are on this site.

q5.q: How do I register a clinic?
q5.a: Press “Register a clinic” and send the clinic name and phone number. You can also write on Telegram: @shifoyol_contact_bot.

q7.q: Does the AI consultant replace a doctor?
q7.a: No. It offers general guidance on symptoms, conditions, lab results, and choosing a clinic or doctor. For a medical decision, speak with a doctor.

q8.q: What are the limits of the Starter plan?
q8.a: Starter is $70 per month: a clinic profile and login, patient bookings, up to 5 services, 1 branch, 1 administrator, and no analytics. Pro is $100 per month and adds analytics, doctor accounts, prescriptions, unlimited branches, and up to 3 administrators.

privacy_page.title: Privacy policy
privacy_page.intro: ShifoYo'l (“we”, “our”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, use, and protect when you use our platform.
privacy_page.s1_text: When you register, book a clinic, or use the app, we may collect your name, email, phone number, and medical information such as appointments and medication reminders. This information is used to provide and improve the service.
privacy_page.s2_text: Collected information is used only to provide the service, send personal reminders, improve the platform, and meet legal requirements. ShifoYo'l does not sell your information to third parties.
privacy_page.s3_text: Your information is supported by encrypted connections and secure servers. Even so, transmission over the Internet cannot be guaranteed to be 100% secure.
privacy_page.s4_text: We use cookies and similar technologies to understand how the website and app are used. You can manage cookies in your browser settings.
privacy_page.s5_text: If you have a privacy question, contact us at shifo.yol@gmail.com.
